incidents.name: DYNA staking reward business-logic flaw
incidents.notes: DYNA spawns a StakingReward contract per holder and the sold-amount limit in transfer() can be bypassed by routing through those contracts, so the attacker pre-seeded 200 of them and later drained the pair.

sources.ref: onchain review: DYNA 0x5c0d0111ffc638802c9EfCcF55934D5C63aB3f79 created 2023-01-31T20:13:40Z by 0xa8ff6c807654c5b2b55f188e9a7ce31c8d192353, unrelated to attack sender 0x0c925a25fdaac4460cab0cc7abc90ff71f410094; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. lossUsd uses the ~$21k reported by DeFiHackLabs and Beosin; the attack spanned two transactions.
